items.question: Where do we start?
items.answer: With a task that comes back often, takes time and causes errors. On a free 30-minute first call, we look at your processes with you and tell you honestly which ones are worth automating.

items.question: Do you always need AI to automate?
items.answer: No, and often you don't. When a simple rule will do, it is more reliable and cheaper. We keep AI for the steps that need to read, understand or classify content that varies.

items.question: What if AI gets it wrong?
items.answer: We test on your data before going live. When AI is not sure enough, the case goes to a person, and sensitive steps always keep a human approval. You keep your current software, nothing is replaced.

items.question: Where does our data go?
items.answer: We favour hosting in Europe and business AI plans that do not train on your data. Before going live, we check where every piece of information travels.

items.question: How much does it cost, and how do we measure the gain?

items.question: Who does the work?

items.question: Can it connect to our tools?

items.question: How long does it take?

items.answer: It gets things wrong less often, because it answers from your data instead of guessing, but the risk does not disappear. ui-ux-design.intro: UX, short for user experience, is how easily someone gets a job done on your website or app. UI, the user interface, is what they see: screens, buttons, text and layout. A mobile app idea that needs testing before money goes into development
A website in Arabic and English that must read well right to left

items.question: Why design before building?
items.answer: Changing a prototype takes hours, changing finished software takes much longer. Testing the design first means your development budget goes into screens people have already shown they can use.

faq.title: Questions about AI skills and assistants

items.question: What exactly is a "skill"?
items.answer: A set of instructions AI follows to the letter for a specific task. For example: "from this customer request, prepare a quote with our template, our prices and our terms". The employee writes it once, then reuses it every time the task comes back.

items.question: Do people need to code?
items.answer: No. Skills are written in everyday language, and the tools we use to connect AI to your software do not require programming. For the more technical connections, a Qartmina engineer handles them with you.

items.question: How is this different from AI training?
items.answer: Training teaches your teams to use AI well in their daily work. Here they go further: they build their own skills, connect AI to their tools and share an assistant that knows your business. You can start with either.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of teams, the tools to connect and the number of workshops. The price is agreed with you before we start.

items.question: Is our data protected when AI is connected to our tools?
items.answer: Each assistant only reaches the information it needs, with the access rights of the person using it. We favour business plans that do not train on your data, and GDPR is built in from the design stage.

items.question: What if a skill gets it wrong?
items.answer: Every skill is tested on real cases before it is shared, and a person approves anything that goes to a customer or commits the company. When a mistake shows up, the team fixes the recipe once, for every time after.

points.title: Understand your teams and tasks
points.text: We talk with management and a few employees to find the tasks that take the most time, the tools already in place and where everyone stands.

points.title: A programme for each role

points.text: Your teams practise on their actual tasks, not on demos. Within a few weeks the new methods are part of daily work, then we extend to other teams.

points.text: Follow-up, answers to questions, a good-practice guide and validation rules: your teams carry on alone and train new joiners themselves.

items.question: Our employees already use ChatGPT. Why train them?
items.answer: Using AI and using it well are not the same thing. A few workshops on their real tasks clearly improve the answers they get, and clear rules stop sensitive data from ending up in the wrong place.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: It depends on the number of teams, participants and workshops. The price is agreed with you before we start, with no surprises afterwards.

items.question: Do people need technical skills?

items.question: On site or remote?

items.question: Is our data safe during the training?
items.answer: Yes. We work on anonymised or made-up examples until your tools are set up correctly, and we help you choose business plans that do not train on your data. GDPR is part of the programme.

items.question: What if the team stops using it after the training?
items.answer: That is the main risk, which is why coaching follows the workshops. We look with you at what is being used and what is getting in the way, and we adjust the programme.

items.text: Hiring engineers, choosing tools, securing data and keeping systems running is a business of its own. You should not have to start it from zero.

items.title: Partnering beats building alone
items.text: In MIT's 2025 study of AI in business, tools built with an outside partner made it past the pilot and into real use about 67% of the time. Tools built in-house: about 33%.

bring.title: Two kinds of know-how. One product.
bring.intro: Think of an architect and a builder. One knows what the house must be, the other knows how to make it stand. Neither builds a great house alone.

you.title: You bring the business brain
items: Your method: frameworks, checklists, templates and the way you work
Deep knowledge of your sector and its rules
Your client relationships and the trust behind them
The judgement on what a good answer looks like

us.title: We bring the tech brain
items: AI agents and multi-step agent systems, designed, built and hosted
Connections to the tools your clients already use: email, documents, client databases (CRM), business software (ERP)
Skills for the agent, open source or built for you, and the data behind them
Security, monitoring and 99% uptime in production
Maintenance and new versions as AI moves on

together.title: Together: your method, as a product.
together.text: A co-branded AI agent your firm can offer to every client in your sector. You go from selling hours to selling a digital product, and you digitalise your own firm along the way. We grow together: your expertise makes our engineering useful, our engineering makes your expertise scale. Both of us own what we create.

steps.title: From first call to a product in production

items.title: Partner call
items.text: We learn how your firm works, which problem your clients pay you to solve, and where an agent would earn its keep.

items.title: Your method, mapped
items.text: You share your frameworks, documents and examples of good work. We turn them into the agent's knowledge, rules and tools.

items.title: First working agent
items.text: A working prototype, not slides. You try it on a real case.

items.title: Teach and test, together
items.text: We go back and forth. You review the answers, we adjust, until you say the output is what you would deliver yourself.

items.title: Live in production
items.text: The agent runs securely, connected to the tools it needs, monitored, with 99% uptime.

items.title: Launch and grow together
items.text: We bring the product to your clients under both brands, learn from real use and keep improving it.

items.question: Do we need technical staff?
items.answer: No. We handle the design, build, hosting, security and maintenance. Your team brings the method and reviews the output.

items.question: Who owns the product?
items.answer: We create it together and both own it. The exact terms, including what each of us can do with it later, are set in a partnership agreement before we start.

items.question: How do we teach the agent our way of working?
items.answer: You share your documents, frameworks and examples. We turn them into the agent's knowledge and rules, then test it with you case by case until the answers meet your standard. After launch you can keep updating its knowledge yourself.

items.question: Can we offer it to several clients?
items.answer: Yes, that is the idea. We build one product for your sector, then set it up for each client with their own data and tools.

items.question: What happens to our clients' data?
items.answer: Each client's data stays separate. We agree with every client where their data is stored and who can see it, and we sign a confidentiality agreement before any data is shared.

items.question: What kind of agents can we build?
items.answer: Anything your method can describe: assistants that answer from your knowledge base, agents that draft reports, audits or proposals, or multi-step systems that work inside your clients' tools.
